data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing native ObjectBox NoSQL database libraries
data.what_it_does: Adds the native ObjectBox runtime libraries for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux to a Flutter project. It enables the ObjectBox Dart package to access the underlying database engine.
use_when: You want a fast, on-device NoSQL database in Flutter
You are already using the ObjectBox Dart package and need native support
avoid_when: You prefer a pure Dart solution or a different database like SQLite or Hive
weaknesses: Only works with ObjectBox, not a standalone DB solution
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; no extra native configuration needed.
